channel.title: The Grant Desk - AI & Safety, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: AI & Safety, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant, instead of trickling out daily. Each Sunday's drop carries every grant added that week, except any closing on the drop day itself.

item.title: 6 new AI & Safety grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Numeric 2026: The Word (Les antipodes Research and Creation Residency)
    https://lesantipodes.com/numeric/2026_bases_en.html
    Les antipodes, with Bolit Centre d'Art Contemporani Girona and Museu de l'Emporda Figueres · deadline 08 Sep 2026 · Two grants. Each provides a stipend of EUR 1,000 as taxable base (taxes and withholdings apply), round-trip travel within the European Union, and accommodation and meals for the four weeks in Agullana. Travel and meals cover the resident only, though the shared apartment can host immediate family by arrangement. Numeric also provides the resources specified in the application and agreed during preparation. No application fee. Note that if a selected candidate lacks the professional registration needed to receive the stipend and payment has to be arranged through Les antipodes, the resulting costs are deducted from the stipend.
  • Normsy: Social Media Measurement Methods Incubator RFP
    https://normsy.ai/labs/openrfp
    Normsy (a project of Civic Health Project) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · USD 1,000 awarded to each of the top 5 proposals, plus up to USD 20,000 to fund R&D and/or testing with one selected partner individual or team. Preference for budgets where at least 50 percent goes to research costs (survey respondents, LLM or X API credits). No application fee.
  • BOLD Fellow, British Open-ended Learning and Discovery Lab
    https://eng.ox.ac.uk/jobs/job-detail?vacancyID=187853
    University of Oxford, Department of Engineering Science (BOLD Lab, with UCL and Imperial College London) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Salary on Oxford Grade 10R, GBP 65,336 to GBP 84,663 per year, with the posting noting that further salary options are being explored. Benefits include associate membership at Reuben College, 38 days annual leave, pension scheme, childcare services, and travel expenses for stakeholder and conference visits. Fellows also get access to substantial compute: 3 million GPU hours on Isambard for the first 18 months, with the lab working towards 5,000 H100-equivalents in total across industry and government support. No application fee.
  • AI ART AWARD: NEXT ART AI 2026
    https://next-art-ai.com/en/apply/overview
    HOBAN Cultural Foundation · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Total prize pool of KRW 21,000,000 across 20 winners, paid after deduction of applicable taxes and public charges. Grand Prize KRW 5,000,000 (selected regardless of category); in each of the two categories, First Prize KRW 2,000,000, three Second Prizes of KRW 1,000,000 each, and five Honorable Finalist awards of KRW 500,000 each; plus a HOBAN Group President's Award of KRW 1,000,000. Winners also receive plaques and certificates, online and offline exhibition opportunities, and a feature on the official online platform. No entry fee is mentioned.
  • Rest of World: Labor x Tech Reporting Commissions (Year 3)
    https://restofworld.org/rest-of-worlds-labor-x-tech-reporting/
    Rest of World, underwritten by the Ford Foundation · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 1,000 per commissioned story of 800 to 1,000 words. No application fee.
  • ILIAD Intensive: Foundational AI Alignment Program (London and Berkeley)
    https://www.iliad.ac/intensive
    ILIAD · deadline Rolling / undated · No tuition. USD 5,000 travel and housing allowance per participant, plus office space at the venue and lunch and dinner five days a week. Cohorts of 15 to 30 participants. Participants arrange and pay for their own travel and accommodation out of the allowance.
